## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Sep 30, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Daniel Baumbart_, Sep 27, 2026, 1/5: "202609: app doesn't crash a lot anymore but I can't delete wrong automatic entries in sleep so the data is wrong and will get worse over time :( 202509: crashes a lot since the newest update"
            2. _JWM B_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
            3. _Richa Suri_, Sep 30, 2026, 2/5: "The Samsung Health app is calculating wrong distance under the Steps section while walking. It is overestimating the distance covered by 20% more than actual. Have tried on multiple different Samsung mobile phone models of and all of them are miscalculating by this much. For e.g., if actual distance covered is 1000 meters while walking, the Samsung Health app shows around 1200 meters. I also have Google Fit app and it shows the correct distance. Please rectify this bug asap"
